name_reason: Compliant with global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix + graphics domain + static_bg_buffer_ptr descriptor that correctly reflects the data type (a runtime base pointer to a heap buffer). No Ghidra-address residue in the name. Accurately distinguishes it from the sibling data_fd2_graphics_animated_bg_buffer_ptr @ 0x53B03.
purpose: Runtime base pointer to the heap-allocated static (non-animated) chapter/battle background work buffer.
logic_summary: Zero-initialized BSS pointer (NULL at startup via CRT BSS-zero). Owned by fd2_load_chapter_background_layers, which per chapter load free()s the previous buffer, NULLs it, then for the active chapter either malloc(bg_w*bg_h) for wide-parallax chapters (0x11/0x15/0x16/0x1B) or malloc(0xEA00) for the chapter-0x17 text-scroll cinematic, blitting FDOTHER.DAT sprites into it, or assigns the result of fd2_load_dat_resource("FDOTHER.DAT", idx) directly for the single-sprite default path. Consumed read-only as a base address by two readers: fd2_composite_battle_tile_map (per-frame background blit source, strides 0x140/0x1CE/0x198/0x138 depending on chapter; for animated chapters 9/0x18/0x19/0x1C/0x1D it is instead the destination of a per-row-offset copy from the animated buffer) and fd2_scroll_text_screen_up_by_lines (in-place cylinder scroll of the 0xC0-line x 0x138-byte buffer via malloc scratch + memmove).
datatype: uint32 (holds a void* heap pointer; Ghidra type undefined4, 4 bytes; callers cast to void*/int/ushort* for pointer arithmetic and free())
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer value = base address of the most recently allocated/loaded static background buffer for the current chapter, or NULL when no buffer is currently owned.
notes: Existing src comment block (rsrc.c lines 729-748) is already precise, complete, ASCII-only, and verified accurate against the writer (fd2_load_chapter_background_layers) and both readers (fd2_composite_battle_tile_map, fd2_scroll_text_screen_up_by_lines) -> comment_verdict=keep, no Edit to rsrc.c. Ghidra plate was empty (<null>) so a concise plate consistent with the src conclusion was created. Not const: WRITE xrefs from fd2_load_chapter_background_layers @ 0x10683/0x10744/0x107EA/0x10871. Sibling animated buffer ptr @ 0x53B03 (data_fd2_graphics_animated_bg_buffer_ptr). Pre-existing unrelated modified shards (000111ba/0002d392/0002d85f/00053c13) left untouched; staged only this shard.
